text:
Nora: Quick follow-up from the APAC failover postmortem. Want concrete owners + dates. Two recurring patterns: restore manifest corruption and asymmetric routing after RR election.

Jin: I'll take the routing mitigation (prefer explicit preference fence + health-check tie-break). ETA 2026-04-10.

Omar: I'll dig into the snapshot manifest corruption. Seeing checksum mismatches when replication overlaps. Will add an integrity verifier to the snapshot pipeline. Target 2026-04-02.

Priya: Runbook gaps: no pre-cutover traffic-sample, and rollback criteria unclear. I'll update runbook to include sample step + explicit rollback signals. Due 2026-03-31.

Maya: I can own the game-day checklist additions and run the next dry-run in staging. Need a 90-min slot next week.

ops-bot: Calendar: staging dry-run reserved 2026-03-30 15:00-16:30 UTC. Invites sent to @oncall, @Maya, @Jin, @Omar.

infra-bot: Incident APAC-2026-03-27: closed. Follow-ups created: 5.

Nora: Canonical AI list (will import to GH Project and label "apac-failover-ai"):

```
AI-201 | RR election tie-break mitigation         | owner: Jin   | due: 2026-04-10
AI-202 | Snapshot integrity verifier               | owner: Omar  | due: 2026-04-02
AI-203 | Runbook: traffic-sample + rollback rules  | owner: Priya | due: 2026-03-31
AI-204 | Staging dry-run + notes                   | owner: Maya  | due: 2026-03-30
AI-205 | Warm-standby cost sketch                  | owner: Nora  | due: 2026-04-05
```

Jin: I'll add a CI regression that simulates RR elections and verifies path symmetry.

Omar: Snapshot verifier will be a pre-mark script that checks checksum + object counts, small lambda. I'll open GH issue and PR.

Priya: For rollback rules: propose thresholds: active session drop >5% for >2m OR steering mismatch >25% for 1m. Will document.

Nora: Finance: quick ballpark for warm-standby (snap retention + minimal compute) before we propose commit? @finance-bot

finance-bot: Created estimate ticket CE-4620. Preliminary ballpark: ~$4k/mo with cross-region replication. Final by 2026-04-05.

Maya: Noted blocker: test harness needs synthetic traffic generator update to include long-lived sessions. I'll file issue and tag @Jin.

Jin: Ack, will review harness change.

Nora: I'll tag related incidents "apac-fail-pattern" for analytics and enable weekly digest to #incidents.

infra-bot: Weekly digest scheduled: every Monday 09:00 UTC.

Priya: Slight ask: owners should post a 1-line status in this thread if any AI slips past due. Helps the DR sync triage.

Nora: Agreed. We'll review in next DR sync on 2026-04-07. Closing thread unless blockers surface.

infra-bot: Follow-up checklist updated: 5 open AIs.
